notices.short_title: NAE for Provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans
notices.description:
The Department Social Services (DSS) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) contract with New York County Health Services Review Organization (NYCHSRO) for provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans. NYCHSRO provides three fulltime equivalent physicians to assist Home Care Service Program with developing and reviewing client home care plans citywide, for Medicaid eligible individuals who are medically and/or physically disabled, frail or elderly in need of home care.

The proposed NAE term will be from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 with a contract amount of $373,238.50. All Renewals and Amendment Extensions were exhausted before utilizing the NAE method. The proposed NAE is being pursued to ensure the continuity of vital services for Program to determine the plan of care for clients while the proposals received from the RFP (EPIN06926P0003) are being evaluated with anticipated contract start date for January 1, 2027.

Procurement and award are in accordance with PPB Rule Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) for the reasons set forth herein.

notices.description: DEP is responsible for operating, maintaining and protecting the Citys upstate water supply. For more than twenty years, DEP has been operating the Catskill/Delaware water supply under specific terms mandated by the series of Filtration Avoidance Determinations, most recently issued as the 2017 Filtration Avoidance Determination (FAD). Pursuant to the Revised 2-17 FAD, the City agreed to provide additional funding for CW Corp.s related operational costs, the services of the Stormwater Technical Assistant position and certain construction management services in connection with the construction of CW Corp.s office building (Arkville Facility) located at 669 County Route 38, Arkville, New York. Section 3.5 of the 2017 FAD issued by the NYSDOH also requires the City to contract with CW Corp. to provide adequate funding for an appropriate position at CW Corp. to assist applicants undertaking regulated activities to comply with the stormwater provisions of the Watershed Regulations (Stormwater Technical Assistant). Operating Funds under this contract may be used only to pay the operating costs of CW Corp. incurred on or after the effective date, including, without limitation repayment…

notable.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notable.short_title: NAE for Provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans
notable.description:
The Department Social Services (DSS) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) contract with New York County Health Services Review Organization (NYCHSRO) for provision of Independent Client Home Care Services Plans. NYCHSRO provides three fulltime equivalent physicians to assist Home Care Service Program with developing and reviewing client home care plans citywide, for Medicaid eligible individuals who are medically and/or physically disabled, frail or elderly in need of home care.

The proposed NAE term will be from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 with a contract amount of $373,238.50. All Renewals and Amendment Extensions were exhausted before utilizing the NAE method. The proposed NAE is being pursued to ensure the continuity of vital services for Program to determine the plan of care for clients while the proposals received from the RFP (EPIN06926P0003) are being evaluated with anticipated contract start date for January 1, 2027.

Procurement and award are in accordance with PPB Rule Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) for the reasons set forth herein.

IDIQ Contract for the Purchase, Installation, Maintenance Including Water Sampling, Servicing, And Repair of Supplemental Chlorination Systems for Treatment of Hot and/or Cold-Water Distribution Systems at Various NYCHA Developments, Citywide

Contract Term: 3 years from the award date on NYCHAs Purchase Order.  NYCHA, in its sole discretion, shall have the option to extend the Term of this Contract for up to two one-year renewal options.

Bid Security: $50,000

Payment & Performance Bonds: $50,000 along with a letter from the vendors bonding company certifying that the bonding company will provide the vendor with performance and payment bonding capacity up to the maximum amount of the Contract over the duration of the Contracts term, $3,000,000
notable.plain: The New York City Housing Authority is seeking bids, due Aug. 13, 2026, for a three-year contract, with two optional one-year extensions, to buy, install, maintain and repair supplemental chlorination systems that treat hot and cold water at NYCHA developments citywide.

Contractor: LiRo-H2Bravo Housing Partners
